character.name: Tucker
description: A retired saboteur. His cards manipulate <c=keyword>the enemy's shield</c> and <c=keyword>positioning</c>.

bluntAttack.name: Blunt attack
bluntAttack.description: Damage and effects are <c=downside>completely negated by shields.</c>

shieldSteal.name: Shield steal
shieldSteal.description: Steal up to <c=keyword>{{Amount}}</c> <c=status>SHIELD</c> from the enemy and apply it to yourself. If they have no shield, steal <c=status>TEMP SHIELD</c> instead.

description.single: Attack <c=keyword>{{Amount}}</c> space to the {{Direction}} of your cannon.
description.many: Attack <c=keyword>{{Amount}}</c> spaces to the {{Direction}} of your cannon.

description.left: The enemy will instantly move {{Amount}} spaces to the <c=keyword>LEFT</c>.
description.right: The enemy will instantly move {{Amount}} spaces to the <c=keyword>RIGHT</c>.

FuelLeak.name: Fuel Leak
FuelLeak.description: Take {0} damage for every space moved. <c=downside>Decreases by 1 at the end of each turn.</c>

Buffer.name: Buffer
Buffer.description: Gain {0} <c=status>TEMP SHIELD</c> each turn. <c=downside>Decreases by 1 afterwards.</c>

AntiqueMotor.name: ANTIQUE MOTOR
AntiqueMotor.description: Gain 1 extra <c=energy>ENERGY</c> every turn. <c=downside>Gain 1 <c=status>FUEL LEAK</c> every turn.

ArtofWar.name: ART OF WAR
ArtofWar.description: When out of shields, gain a <c=card>Counter Attack</c>.

AlwaysBeCountering.name: ALWAYS BE COUNTERING
AlwaysBeCountering.description: Whenever you play a <c=keyword>B</c> upgraded card immediately after playing an <c=keyword>A</c> upgraded card, gain a <c=card>Counter Attack</c>.

Cryostasis.name: CRYOSTASIS
Cryostasis.description: While you have <c=status>ENGINE LOCK</c> or <c=status>ENGINE STALL</c>, gain 1 less <c=status>HEAT</c> from all cards.

GrouchoStache.name: GROUCHO 'STACHE
GrouchoStache.description: At the start of every turn, if you have any <c=status>ENGINE LOCK</c>, gain 1 <c=status>TEMP SHIELD</c> for each <c=status>EVADE</c> you have.

Hyperlink.name: HYPERLINK
Hyperlink.description: Gain a <c=card>Redirect</c> when playing an <c=card>EXE</c> card.

NavyTraining.name: NAVY TRAINING
NavyTraining.description: At the start of combat, add an <c=card>Anchor</c> into your deck. Whenever you draw an Anchor, gain 2 <c=status>TEMP SHIELD</c> and 1 <c=status>BUFFER</c>.

PetBed.name: PET BED
PetBed.description: While you have <c=status>ENGINE LOCK</c> or <c=status>ENGINE STALL</c>, increase the value of X on all cards by 2.

ProPain.name: PRO-PAIN
ProPain.description: Piercing attacks inflict 1 <c=status>HEAT</c>. Blunt attacks inflict 2 <c=status>HEAT</c>.

RCRemote.name: RC REMOTE
RCRemote.description: Whenever you gain <c=status>ENGINE LOCK</c> or <c=status>ENGINE STALL</c>, apply 1 <c=status>AUTOPILOT</c> to the enemy.

ShieldBash.name: SHIELD BASH
ShieldBash.description: <c=action>Blunt attacks</c> deal +1 damage for every 3 <c=status>TEMP SHIELD</c> you have, +1 damage for every 2 <c=status>SHIELD</c>, +1 damage for every <c=status>PRISTINE SHIELD</c>, and +2 damage for every <c=status>PERFECT SHIELD</c>.

ToolsOfTheTrade.name: TOOLS OF THE TRADE
ToolsOfTheTrade.description: Whenever you <c=action>shield steal</c>, gain 1 more of whatever shield type you stole.

WarTable.name: WAR TABLE
WarTable.description: After playing 8 <c=e9bd5c>Tucker</c> cards in a combat, gain 1 <c=status>TABLE FLIP</c>.

Whetstone.name: WHETSTONE
Whetstone.description: Whenever a <c=action>blunt attack</c> hits shield, spend 1 <c=status>SHARD</c> to convert it into a regular attack.

WireTap.name: WIRE TAP
WireTap.description: When you end your turn with <c=status>ENGINE LOCK</c> or <c=status>ENGINE STALL</c>, gain 1 <c=status>DRONESHIFT</c>.

Idea.name: URANIUM IDEA
Idea.description: On pickup, add a <c=card>Uranium Round A</c> to your deck.

Honor.name: URANIUM HONOR
Honor.description: On pickup, add a <c=card>Uranium Round A</c> to your deck. Whenever you play a <c=card>Uranium Round</c>, draw 1.

Table.name: URANIUM TABLE
Table.description: On pickup, add 3 <c=card>Uranium Rounds A</c> to your deck. <c=parttrait>None shall stand in your path.</c>

RoundTable.name: URANIUM ROUND TABLE
RoundTable.description: Draw <c=keyword>1 card</c> whenever you play a <c=c9f000>Philip</c> card. <c=keyword>+1</c> <c=energy>ENERGY</c> and <c=card>card</c> per turn. <c=keyword>+20</c> <c=hull>max hull</c> and <c=healing>heal 20</c> on pickup. All non-<c=c9f000>Philip</c> cards <c=cardtrait>exhaust</c>.

description.None: Move the enemy 1 space to the {{Direction}}. Gain a <c=card>Redirect</c>.
description.A: Move the enemy 2 spaces to the {{Direction}}. Gain a <c=card>Redirect</c>.

birthdayVictoryChoice1.2: Cleo was the Big Bad this whole time?
birthdayVictoryChoice1.3: Uranium Round shenanigans really were the answer in the end, huh?

birthdayVictoryChoice2.1: So, why are you three here?
birthdayVictoryChoice2.2: What's this 'Uranium Round Table' business about?
birthdayVictoryChoice2.3: What's going to happen with the Cobalt now?
